description: Ex XV-NIA, which escaped from Saigon to U-Tapao 29 April 1975. Moved into the garden here in the late 1980s or early 1990s; marked HS-1SS until about 2013 and now unmarked with Hope International titles and Sukhanetr Air on the fin. Noted April 2025.
museum_name: Hope International Rehabilitation Center Bang Phra
